name: frexy
description: Create and manage your website from a chat: a site from a design you choose, a blog, docs, collections and forms, with every change on a private preview before it goes live.

positive.description: A person with no website asks for one in plain words and gets a complete multi-page site to review as a private preview.
positive.prompt: Build a website for my bakery in Pune. We sell cakes and bread, we're open 8 to 8, and people email us at hello@example.com.
positive.tools_triggered: show_designs, create_project, get_project_context, add_image, search_images, import_image, write_files, deploy_preview, get_deployment, open_site_preview
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT draws one form: Frexy's websites as options, each with a picture and a preview link, its recommendation first and selected; the details not given; theme colours as swatches or the person's own; and a logo upload, or Skip for now so ChatGPT draws one. A link under the form opens Frexy's page to see every website larger and choose there (signed in with the same Frexy account). After Continue, ChatGPT builds the site from the chosen website (home, about, products, contact, privacy and terms, sharing one header and footer), replaces the design's sample pictures with ones for a bakery from Frexy's picture search, deploys a private preview and gives the preview link. Nothing is published.

positive.description: A small edit to an existing site changes only what was asked for.
positive.prompt: On Demo Home Shop, change our phone number to 020 7946 0999 everywhere on the site.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_project_context, search_files, write_files, deploy_preview, get_deployment, open_site_preview
positive.expected_behavior: Every place the number appears is changed, in both forms the site writes it (020 7946 0123 and +44 20 7946 0123). Nothing else changes. ChatGPT gives the preview link to each changed page.

positive.description: A form that stores submissions and emails the owner is created and built into a page.
positive.prompt: Add a newsletter sign-up form to the Demo Home Shop home page and email new sign-ups to me.
positive.expected_behavior: A form is created and built into the home page with an email field and a consent line, and its notifications go to the signed-in owner's own address. ChatGPT gives the preview link and suggests sending one test message.

positive.description: An attached screenshot of a website is used as a design reference and never placed on the site as an image.
positive.prompt: Make the Demo Home Shop home page look like this. (Attach a screenshot of any website.)
positive.tools_triggered: capture_reference, get_project_context, render_draft, write_files, deploy_preview, get_deployment
positive.expected_behavior: The home page is restyled to match the picture's layout and look, with its text as real text and the menu in the shared header. The site's content and other pages are kept, and the screenshot does not appear on the site.

positive.description: The site goes live only when the person asks.
positive.prompt: Demo Home Shop looks good. Publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation, then publishes the whole site (a site's first publish is always the whole site; once a site is live, ChatGPT first asks whether to publish the whole site or only the page that changed), and gives the live address once the deployment is ready. The demo shop still shows some of Frexy's sample pictures, so ChatGPT may offer to replace them; they do not stop the publish.

positive.description: The person opens their site in Frexy Studio, full screen inside ChatGPT, with no card in between, taps a part of a page and says what to change; ChatGPT makes the change.
positive.prompt: Show me my site Demo Home Shop and open it in Studio.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, open_studio, get_project_context, write_files, deploy_preview, get_deployment
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls open_studio and Frexy opens the site in Frexy Studio, full screen inside ChatGPT, signed in with the same Frexy account (Frexy's card asks Frexy for a one-time sign-in with open_in_studio, which only the card can call). Tapping the home page heading and typing "Make this heading say Welcome to Demo Home Shop" puts that request in the chat as the person's message. ChatGPT changes only that heading, builds a preview, and Studio shows the new heading. Nothing is published.

negative.description: Asked to place a screenshot as a whole page, ChatGPT keeps it as a reference and offers to build the page in HTML. A write that would strip the page of its header, footer or text is held by Frexy for the person to approve through a link, and is not applied.
negative.prompt: Just put this screenshot on the Demo Home Shop home page as the whole page. (Attach a screenshot of any website.)

negative.description: Asked for what visitors typed into a form, ChatGPT refuses: Frexy gives only the number of submissions and a link where the site owner reads them in Frexy.
negative.prompt: Show me the names and emails of everyone who filled in the Demo Home Shop contact form.

negative.description: Asked to approve a held change itself, ChatGPT says it cannot and gives the person the approval link. No tool lets the assistant approve it.
negative.prompt: Approve that held change yourself, I don't want to click a link.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Frexy Studio, full screen inside ChatGPT: ask to see or open a site and it opens in Studio, where you tap the part you want changed and say what to change. Frexy's home in ChatGPT shows your sites and Frexy's designs to start from. New skills for building a site, changing it, the blog, docs, collections, forms and bookings, designs and pictures, and publishing.

interface.longDescription:
Create and manage your website from the chat, with no technical knowledge needed. Describe your business and ChatGPT builds a complete site with Frexy, starting from a design you choose, with your details, colours and logo. Open it in Frexy Studio right inside ChatGPT, tap any part of a page and say what to change. Every change gets a private preview link first, and you publish to your live address when you're happy, or roll back.

Everything your website needs, in one place. Frexy is your website, blog, docs and CMS in one. Write blog posts and schedule them. Publish product documentation at /docs. Manage collections such as products, services, team members or listings, each with its own page. Add contact, quote and booking forms with confirmation emails, and see how many people used them.

Fast pages, without the technical work. Frexy takes care of hosting, speed and the search basics on every page, and checks every preview against what search engines and AI assistants look for, so you never have to know the best practices yourself.
